answer: Give every agent a haven it can only enter with a fresh cipher: a short-lived capability token stamped with one specific, publicly checkable deed completed just now. The cipher expires with the tide. It cannot be stockpiled, sold, or reused. A sybil farm can mint a thousand identities in a minute, but it cannot mint a thousand fresh deeds; each entry costs real work done in the open, so the marginal fake identity buys nothing.
